updates.headline: Canada Extends Post-Graduation Work Permit Eligibility
updates.explanation: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) announced extended PGWP eligibility for graduates from designated learning institutions in select fields including STEM and healthcare.

updates.headline: Updated Student Direct Stream Processing Times
updates.explanation: Processing times for Student Direct Stream (SDS) applications from India have been updated. Students are advised to check current processing times before applying.

updates.headline: Ontario Universities Announce Tuition Framework for International Students
updates.explanation: The Ontario provincial government has released updated tuition fee guidelines for international students for the upcoming academic year.

updates.headline: US STEM OPT Extension Remains Available for Eligible Graduates
updates.explanation: International STEM graduates from accredited US institutions continue to be eligible for a 24-month OPT extension, totaling 36 months of work authorization post-graduation.

updates.headline: FAFSA Simplification Act: Impact on International Students
updates.explanation: While FAFSA primarily serves domestic students, the simplification has prompted some universities to revise their financial aid processes for international students.

updates.headline: US Consulates in India Expand Student Visa Interview Slots
updates.explanation: The US Embassy in India has added additional visa interview slots for student applicants during the peak admission season to reduce wait times.

updates.headline: UK Graduate Route Visa Continues for 2-Year Post-Study Work
updates.explanation: The UK Graduate Route continues to offer international students a 2-year post-study work visa (3 years for doctoral graduates) upon completing a qualifying course.

updates.headline: UK Universities Offer More Scholarships for Indian Students
updates.explanation: Several Russell Group universities have announced expanded scholarship programs targeting Indian students for postgraduate programs in STEM and business.

updates.headline: Australia Introduces New Student Visa Compliance Framework
updates.explanation: The Australian Department of Home Affairs has updated compliance requirements for international student visas, emphasizing genuine temporary entrant criteria.

updates.headline: Australia Increases Post-Study Work Rights for Select Degrees
updates.explanation: Graduates from select degree programs in areas of national priority may now be eligible for extended post-study work rights of up to 4 years.

updates.headline: Germany Maintains Low/No Tuition at Public Universities
updates.explanation: Most German public universities continue to offer tuition-free or very low-cost education for international students, though semester fees (€150–€350) still apply.

updates.headline: Singapore Expands Tech.Pass for International Graduates
updates.explanation: Singapore's Ministry of Manpower has expanded the Tech.Pass program, which may benefit international graduates from Singaporean universities with expertise in tech fields.
